changes: Contains, IsEqual, HasIntersection now use native signed Extent() comparisons rather than unsigned Size()/Rust len().
Contains preserves self/empty-subset shortcuts; IsEqual checks identity first; HasIntersection checks empty first then identity. IsSubset retains native reverse-Contains forwarding.
Predicate loops check the current key before advancing the cursor, avoiding extra user conversions after an early predicate result. Deprecated class members retain direct delegation.
No allocator, ownership, key representation, mutation algorithm or shared ledger changes.

native_matrix.ordinary_pairs: six self identities and every 6x6 distinct pair for each of six types

synthetic_scope.native: -fno-access-control replaces only private myExtent over an unchanged tiny valid node graph; an RAII guard restores it. sizeof(int)==4 and sizeof(size_t)==8 are compile-time assertions.
synthetic_scope.rust: Only cfg(test) child-module code writes private count; each pair restores its saved counts. There is no public metadata-injection API.
synthetic_scope.observations: Exact Size/Extent/IsEmpty, signed smaller-operand expression, four namespace predicates and four legacy member predicates. Native rows independently confirm low32 signed conversion.
synthetic_scope.limitation: These intentionally inconsistent metadata states establish control-flow semantics. They do not simulate actual multi-billion-element node graphs or establish full high-cardinality allocation/traversal parity.

callback_scope: Custom PackedInteger callbacks are a Rust extension; OCCT accepts integral keys. Tests compare Rust no-callback shortcuts and current-key-before-next ordering to the pinned native source, and signed smaller-side choice to the native recorded selection expression. They do not claim a native custom-key callback oracle.

regression_evidence.baseline: Six ordinary matrices passed and five targeted synthetic/shortcut tests failed on unmodified predicates. The final early-next-conversion regression was added after this baseline.
regression_evidence.fixture_decode: OnceLock predecodes the exact committed 1224-row numeric oracle once per process; all rows and all15 columns remain asserted. Tiny maps are reused across synthetic count pairs.

miri_exclusions.reason: Six existing positive libc-backtrace iterator tests remain excluded; all264 originals and all12 new tests run under strict Miri.

bindings.scope: Actual finite-map results and predicate branch/short-circuit order. Synthetic extents prove metadata conversion/control flow only, not complete execution of giant cardinalities. No global API completion credit.

remaining_gaps: Mutation algorithms unite/intersect/subtract/differ still use usize length comparisons rather than native signed extent change comparisons; intersection also chooses its smaller side using len. These are separate concrete method-contract gaps.
Native billion-element graphs, platform/compiler variations, C++ ABI and exception callback differences outside these predicates are not established by synthetic metadata.
Global declaration ledger reconciliation and full class/toolkit parity remain separate; eight scoped bindings are not a full-parity claim.
